seoTitle: Video Production Services | Cambridge & London | FilmEditRun
seoDescription: Explore FilmEditRun's modular video production services across Cambridge and London: event filming, conference coverage, brand films, podcasts, and post-production.
heading: Modular *filming.* <br class="hidden sm:inline" />Agile *post-production.*
description: From live conference stages to executive boardrooms and post-production suites, we deploy crews that capture authentic stories quietly, cleanly, and without disrupting your schedule.
processDescription: A disciplined four-stage process that removes friction regardless of location, protects your schedule, and ensures technical precision from concept to delivery.

processSteps.title: Discovery & Briefing
processSteps.description: We establish your core objectives, shooting schedule, visual treatment, and technical audio requirements before touching a camera.

processSteps.title: On-Location Filming
processSteps.description: Specialist multi-camera setups and clean broadcast audio capture ensure every keynote, interview, and critical moment is recorded with quiet precision.

processSteps.title: Editorial & Review
processSteps.description: Story assembly and pacing cuts are shared via private, frame-accurate review links for fast, friction-free stakeholder feedback.

processSteps.title: Master & Delivery
processSteps.description: Final colour-graded masters, vertical social cutdowns, and burned-in caption files packaged for instant publishing across your website and social channels.

ctaHeading: Have an upcoming project *or production brief?*
ctaText: Tell us about your event dates, venue location, or creative ideas. We deliver a tailored technical scope and quote within 24 hours.
